drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 17.2% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 1.0% higher in 30 days' time (Dec) than now (Nov).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is below the last 5 days' average, and the forecast counts a one-day dip only half, so it starts 1.8% higher than today.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -22.9% to +6.1% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 11.0% on average at 30 days, vs 9.3% for "price stays the same" - it is NOT better than no-change here, so read it as a range, not a number. Direction right 50% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.

rules.english:
2026-11-25 Platinum - STRONG BUY (score +3 of 5): If buying: Good time to buy - buy in 2-3 parts.  If holding: Hold - prices likely to rise.
Why: Mainly because the price is in the cheap part of the year's range and it fell very fast, and such falls often bounce back. Against it: a stronger rupee makes it cheaper in India.
What would change it: Turns BUY if the price rises to Rs 41,644 (+6.0%). Stays STRONG BUY even if it falls 15%.
How sure: Low. Past BUY days (558 since 2017): higher 30 days later on 67% vs 52% of all days -> edge +15 points.
Price: Rs 39,287 per 10 g (Rs 40,466 with 3% GST); 7 days -9.8%, 30 days -21.3%. 30-day outlook Rs 35,626 (likely Rs 30,302 - Rs 41,703).
Saving for years: ADD FOR THE LONG RUN - A good time to add for the long run - still buy in 2-3 parts. Because it is at or below its 3-year average. Not counted (its record disagrees): Change over 12 months, Long trend (200 days).
rules.telugu:
2026-11-25 ప్లాటినం - బాగా కొనండి (స్కోరు +3 / 5)
ఎందుకు: ముఖ్య కారణం: ధర ఈ ఏడాది పరిధిలో తక్కువ భాగంలో ఉంది మరియు చాలా వేగంగా పడిపోయింది, ఇలాంటప్పుడు తరచుగా మళ్ళీ పెరుగుతుంది. వ్యతిరేకంగా: రూపాయి బలపడటం వల్ల భారత్‌లో ధర తగ్గుతుంది.
ఏది మారిస్తే మారుతుంది: ధర Rs 41,644 (+6.0%) కి పెరిగితే కొనండి. ధర 15% తగ్గినా ఇదే సూచన.
నమ్మకం: తక్కువ. గతంలో BUY రోజుల్లో (558 రోజులు) 30 రోజుల తర్వాత 67% సార్లు ధర పెరిగింది; ఏ రోజైనా 52% (తేడా +15).
ధర: 10 గ్రాములకు Rs 39,287 (GST తో Rs 40,466); 7 రోజుల్లో -9.8%, 30 రోజుల్లో -21.3%. 30 రోజుల అంచనా Rs 35,626 (Rs 30,302 - Rs 41,703).
ఏళ్ల తరబడి దాచుకునేవారికి: దీర్ఘకాలానికి కొనండి - దీర్ఘకాలానికి కొనడానికి మంచి సమయం - అయినా 2-3 భాగాలుగా కొనండి. కారణం: ధర 3 ఏళ్ల సగటు కంటే తక్కువగా ఉంది.
